summary: Iteration 482 — SEAL full regression before deployment. Breadth over depth across MyHotelBox landing, ReveniQ landing, Admin core + 4 new panels, Owner Pulse digest, Public Price Checker, AI pricing, Revenue Brain, Smart Rooms, Base Price Curve, STR Market (Airbnb tab). Backend pytest: 13/14 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (owner login — seed credential missing in DB). Frontend Playwright: MyHotelBox landing renders with crosssell-brain-highlight (nested crosssell-brain-link → /reveniq#brain); ReveniQ landing renders #brain section with brain-loop-steps container (4 child items) + brain-showcase-demo-cta + Price Checker section (city+rooms+submit, result card rendered on 1 test query 'Roma'/30 rooms — <=2 queries used, well under 10/h limit); admin login OK; all 4 new sidebar panels (smart-rooms-btn, base-curve-btn, revenue-brain-btn, demo-leads-btn) open and render content (body_len grows to 3-3.5k); Demo Leads shows demo-pc-stats + demo-source-filter-price-checker; Compset → Airbnb/STR tab (compset-tab-str) renders full view with KPIs '7 gün canlı', '148 Aktif STR İlanı', '£96.25 STR Medyan Fiyat', '+35.1% otel vs STR farkı', 60d line chart and Turkish insights (Booking.com live 7 dates + 53 sim). No client-side JS/page errors; only expected 401s on initial unauth polling before token attached. Owner Pulse digest HTML preview contains both 'STR Pazar Zekâsı' and 'Bu Hafta Beyniniz Ne Öğrendi' cards. Public /api/public/price-check with only city (no email) → 200, lead_created=false as spec'd. AI pricing /default/suggestions?days=14&use_llm=false returns 200 with str_mult + learned_mult fields present. Revenue Brain /aldgate-flats/status returns outcomes_measured=8. Base curve /preview?days=540 returns exactly 540 rows. Background workers evidence in logs: str_scan_loop (camden-suites 8/8 live), Smart Scanner Today+Tomorrow/3-7d/1-2wk/2-4wk cycles, Recovery autopilot ran on startup, no tracebacks in last 200 lines. Backend hot-reload hung after first pytest run (known issue) — 1× supervisorctl restart backend + 20s wait restored service; second pytest run passed cleanly.
